title: Local generators for a kernel from kernel conditions on an open cover
statement: Let X be a scheme, F an O_X-module, U an open cover, and f : O_W^{⊕ n} → F|_W. If for every member U_i, open V ⊆ U_i, rank m and map O_V^{⊕ m} → (F|_{U_i})|_V the kernel is of finite type, then the kernel of f admits finite local-generators data on W.

source.place: Definitions 01BV and 01B5 and Section 01AF, section-kernels and the locality argument

proof.text: For each cover member U_i form the slice object W intersection U_i -> W. Apply the fixed-rank single-intersection comparison with the hypothesis hK i restricted to the rank n of f; obtain finite type of the restriction of kernel f to that object.

The intersection objects cover the slice site over W: for an open T -> W and x in T, choose i with x in U_i using the union equality, and use T intersection U_i, which maps both to T and to W intersection U_i. This is proved directly with the pointwise definition of the open-set topology.

Choose finite local generating data for each restricted kernel. Flatten their index types by a dependent sum. CoversTop.over proves the flattened family covers. Map each finite generating family through pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence for Over.iteratedSliceEquiv, then through the counit comparison isomorphism. GeneratingSections.map and ofEpi preserve the finite generator index. This constructs finite local-generators data for kernel f, with index in universe u. This is the generators analogue of Mathlib QuasicoherentData.bind, implemented and proved locally.

proof_origin.place: Definitions 01BV (definition-coherent), 01B5 (definition-finite-type), and Section 01AF (section-kernels); proved cover and generator flattening, with the single-intersection comparison split off; Mathlib QuasicoherentData.bind supplies the iterated-slice construction pattern

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_kernel_condition_local_generators
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (I : Type u) (U : I → X.Opens) (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (hK : ∀ (i : I) (V : (U i).toScheme.Opens) (n : ℕ)
      (f : SheafOfModules.free (R := (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over V)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj F).over V),
      (kernel f).IsFiniteType)
    (W : X.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (f : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      F.over W) :
    ∃ σ : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} (kernel f), σ.IsFiniteType
lean.note: The local-generators index universe is explicitly u, the site universe, rather than an unintended independent universe. See coord/changes/coherent-kernel-local-generators-universe.md.
